summary: Tested 2 new features: (1) Reports 'Deployment Roster Export' report type with roster filter (All/TIFMAS/EMTF) + CSV export via dropdown; (2) TIFMAS + EMTF Rank pages new Roster/Import History tabs backed by new backend endpoints POST /api/deployment-roster/bulk-import-with-history and GET /api/deployment-roster/import-history. All 6 pytest cases PASS and all frontend UI checks PASS.

backend.TestBulkImportWithHistory::test_import_h: PASS - GET returns list containing our filename with id/user_name/total_rows/added/skipped/errors_count/created_at

frontend.Reports page: PASS - report-type-select contains 'Deployment Roster Export'; selecting it reveals roster-export-type-select filter (All/TIFMAS/EMTF); Generate Report renders deployment-roster-export-report with summary cards; Export dropdown exposes export-csv-btn
frontend.TIFMAS Rank page (/personnel/deployment-: PASS - Roster and Import History tabs render; clicking Import History triggers GET /api/deployment-roster/import-history
frontend.EMTF Rank page (/personnel/deployment-tr: PASS - Roster and Import History tabs render; clicking Import History triggers GET /api/deployment-roster/import-history and displays the two seeded test rows with filename/user/added/skipped columns

critical_code_review_comments: Tabs (TabsTrigger for 'Roster' and 'Import History') in TIFMASRankPage.js and EMTFRankPage.js don't have data-testid attributes. Consider adding data-testid='tab-roster' and data-testid='tab-history' for more robust selection than get_by_role.
The Import History table rows also lack data-testid; adding data-testid={`import-history-row-${idx}`} would improve testability.
existing_names query for bulk-import-with-history is still capped at .to_list(1000). For tenants with >1000 roster entries, duplicates may be added. Same finding as iteration 42.

The 'filename' parameter on POST /deployment-roster/bulk-import-with-history is passed as a query-string arg (FastAPI signature `filename: str = None`), not in the JSON body. This works but a body field would be cleaner.
import_history entries include tenant_id/user_id but no index defined - consider index on (tenant_id, created_at) for scaling.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_HISTORY_* roster entries + two import_history rows (unit_test.csv and unit_test_<hex>.csv) inserted; not cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 items in the review request verified end-to-end. Backend: POST bulk-import-with-history returns history_id and creates row; GET import-history returns the list scoped by tenant. Frontend: Reports 'Deployment Roster Export' works with filter+CSV; TIFMAS/EMTF pages have Roster and Import History tabs, and clicking Import History fires the GET call. If further tests are needed for CSV download itself, use page.expect_download() after clicking export-csv-btn.
